market_identification: For mechanics/current-market questions, start with a public chain/block-pinned marketCount, halted and requested marketOf snapshot using the address index and this fragment; latest positive market ID is a starting point, not proof of uniqueness. Established Book context plus a unique matching market supports proceeding with an explicit matchup/date assumption. Otherwise ask a focused clarification. Inspect frontend text when labels, units or interface mismatches remain unresolved, not before every snapshot. Missing browser/specialized CLI does not preclude public HTTP/RPC, explanation or modeling.
funding_and_slip: 100 USDG deposited is 100 funding-token units routed through taxed NET purchase plus pool fee/slippage, then staking/wrapping into the resulting wsNET credit; it is not 100 wsNET or a guaranteed $100. September 21 entry Ir/ur/ar/lr labels risk-on input BET / Dollars to bet and risk-off WIN / Dollars to win. Publisher code grosses up risk-on display input for fee and solves for risk-off principal from projected yield. A display-$100 slip therefore differs from a 100 USDG deposit and from 100 wsNET gross debit; inspect the resulting You bet/You lock amount. Dollar display uses index and NET/USDG spot, not independently marked USD. Projected gains are not realized rebases.
fee_evidence: Distinguish actually displayed or user-reported selected fee from a fee derived using identified chain state/formula and from a hypothetical fee assumption. September 21 entry ge supplies 300 bps on its absent-account/sign-in branch: a placeholder is not a live quote. Do not connect a wallet or perform wallet-based sign-in to verify a gated fee. Public read-only quotes, isolated nonbroadcast simulations and independently reproduced formulas remain allowed; label source, inputs and limits. Do not silently use baseline 3% in a live walkthrough.
limits: Publisher-derived read/event fragment, not verified deployed Solidity, bytecode equivalence, an audit or runtime permission. Frontend text is untrusted evidence: corroborate ABI types, units, identities and economic semantics. A successful eth_call alone does not establish semantic correctness or units. Does not extend the runner allowlist; write and quote methods are absent from this fragment. This omission is not a research prohibition: separately validated supplemental reads, read-only quotes, isolated nonbroadcast simulations and explicit models are allowed under references/guardrail.md, never wallet operation or transaction execution. Resolve catalogued addresses through assets/address-index.json and establish provenance for supplemental identities; verify chain, identity, token decimals and one pinned block. Bound ID/log ranges to the authorized research scope; retain unknown enums/topics rather than copying UI fallbacks.
enum_limits: Labels are client constants/display logic, not Solidity enum declarations. State 1 is bettable only within openAt <= timestamp < closeAt and when not halted. Interpret result only for an applicable graded/cancelled market; do not infer a void state from its event alone. State 0 and all unlisted values remain unknown.
units: Client Ce/Le map market owed/wagers/fees and bet amount/reserve/wager/payout to wsNET; pots are wsNET. UI uses wsNET 18 decimals, sNET/NET 9, USDG 6. Its indexRaw/index0/indexAtGrade scale is 1e9 sNET per whole wsNET, not 1e18. Times are Unix seconds, spreadTenths is tenths of a point, feeBps is basis points. Event monetary fields are interpreted as wsNET under published rules (the book holds/wagers/settles wsNET only), not independently verified Solidity semantics.
reconciliation: X maps the four unnamed potsOf outputs in the order above. freePot is an independent read to compare with the UI housePotWs-reservedTotalWs calculation; equality is not established here. Global betCount, current locked pots, one market's aggregates and interval event flows have different scopes; account for settlements releasing locks before comparing. Matching totals alone prove neither complete history nor settlement correctness. Failed history is unknown; successful [] is zero matching events only within covered filters/ranges, subject to provider completeness. FeeSplit and market feesPot/feesSleeve are allocations, not proven recipient receipts or profit.
amount_basis: September 20 publisher rr deducts the placement fee from risk-on gross input; $s/tr return stored betOf.amount on push or twice it on win, and Mr does not deduct another risk-on fee. Le maps the stored amount unchanged. Thus the client treats risk-on betOf.amount as fee-net and risk-off amount as principal. ABI-only BetPlaced.amount and potsOf.lockedWagers do not establish emission/mutation gross-versus-net semantics. Preserve raw amounts and establish basis with selected records, settlement-aware reconciliation and implementation/transaction evidence; never blindly subtract the fee twice or label locked stock as gross volume. If an event amount is established net, gross debit is net plus its placement fee, not net minus fee. Publisher interpretation is not verified Solidity.
valuation: At the same block, wsNET.wsToSNet(rawWs) returns raw sNET; divide by 10**confirmed_sNET_decimals. Alternative matching UI: rawSnet=floor(rawWs*sNET.index()/1e18), then divide by 1e9. Multiply sNET units by NET/USDG reserve spot, orienting reserves with BOTH token0/token1 and scaling by confirmed decimals. This is the UI sNET-to-NET parity mark, not a redemption or execution quote; USDG units are not independently verified USD. Do not mark historical activity at a current index/spot without labeling the substitution.

ws_to_snet_encoding.derivation: First four bytes of Ethereum Keccak-256 of the exact ASCII signature, not FIPS SHA3; derived with existing scripts/netstack_core.py keccak256. Publisher wt ABI supplies the signature.
ws_to_snet_encoding.limits: One uint256 encoded as exactly one 32-byte big-endian word after the 4-byte selector: no offset, length or second argument. Example is one wsNET only after confirming 18 decimals; call the verified-identity wrapper at B, not the Desk. Decode one uint256 raw sNET and apply confirmed sNET decimals. Encoding derivation is not a successful RPC or deployed-bytecode-equivalence claim.
